scanNote:
IRREGULAR VERBS (128-bet). Katta qora sarlavha 'Irregular Verbs'. Ikki ustunli och sariq jadval: Infinitive | Past | Past Participle. 111 ta fe'l: be - was - been ... write - wrote - written. Chap ustunda kimdir qalam bilan raqamlar yozgan (1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30). Beginner kitobidagi ro'yxat bilan bir xil.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '128'.

exercises.instructionEn: Irregular Verbs — Infinitive / Past / Past Participle
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh USTUN NIMANI ANGLATADI:

  1-USTUN — INFINITIVE (asosiy shakl)
     Present Simple, modal fe'llardan keyin,
     'to' bilan.
        'I GO to school.'
        'You must GO.'
        'I want TO GO.'

  2-USTUN — PAST (2-shakl, V2)
     PAST SIMPLE zamonda.
        'I WENT to school yesterday.'

  3-USTUN — PAST PARTICIPLE (3-shakl, V3)
     PRESENT PERFECT da (have/has + V3)
     va majhul nisbatda.
        'I HAVE GONE.'
        'The car WAS BROKEN.'


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  'DID' va 'DIDN'T' dan keyin — 1-ShAKL!
     'I WENT.'         ✓ (2-shakl)
     'Did you GO?'     ✓ (1-shakl)
     'Did you WENT?'   ✗
     'I didn't GO.'    ✓
     'I didn't WENT.'  ✗

  'HAVE/HAS' dan keyin — 3-ShAKL!
     'I have GONE.'    ✓
     'I have WENT.'    ✗


UCh ASOSIY NAMUNA:

  1) A-A-A — UChALA ShAKL BIR XIL (13 ta):
     cost — cost — cost
     cut — cut — cut
     hit — hit — hit
     hurt — hurt — hurt
     let — let — let
     put — put — put
     set — set — set
     shut — shut — shut
     split — split — split
     spread — spread — spread
     burst — burst — burst
     read — read — read (⚠ TALAFFUZ
        o'zgaradi: /riːd/ → /red/ → /red/)
     beat — beat — beatEN (2 ta bir xil)

  2) A-B-B — 2 va 3-ShAKL BIR XIL
     (eng katta guruh):
     buy — bought — bought
     have — had — had
     make — made — made
     say — said — said
     ...

  3) A-B-C — UChALA ShAKL BOShQA:
     go — went — gone
     see — saw — seen
     do — did — done
     write — wrote — written
     ...


⚠ QAVSDAGI ShAKLLAR:

  Ba'zi fe'llarda IKKI shakl bor:

     burn  — burnt (burned)
     dream — dreamt (dreamed)
     learn — learnt (learned)
     smell — smelt (smelled)
     spell — spelt (spelled)

     BIRINChISI — Britaniya inglizchasi
     QAVSDAGISI — Amerika inglizchasi

  Boshqa qavslar BOShQA MA'NO uchun:

     hang — hung (HANGED)
        hung = osilgan (narsa)
        hanged = osib o'ldirilgan (odam)

     bear — bore — born(E)
        born = tug'ilgan
        borne = ko'tarilgan, chidalgan

     sew — sewed — sewn (SEWED)
     show — showed — shown


⚠ 'CAN' — MAXSUS HOLAT:
  can — could — (been able to)

  'can' ning haqiqiy 3-shakli YO'Q!
  Uning o'rniga 'BE ABLE TO' ishlatiladi:

     hozir:   'I CAN swim.'
     o'tmish: 'I COULD swim.'
     kelajak: 'I WILL BE ABLE TO swim.'
     Perfect: 'I HAVE BEEN ABLE TO swim.'

  ⚠ 'will can' — XATO!
  (113-bet: 'They will not BE ABLE TO
   understand.')


⚠ EN QIYIN JUFTLIK — LIE va LAY:

  Jadvalda IKKALASI ham bor:

     LIE — LAY — LAIN
        = yotmoq (o'zi yotadi)
        'I LIE on the bed.'
        'I LAY on the bed yesterday.'

     LAY — LAID — LAID
        = qo'ymoq, yotqizmoq (nimanidir)
        'I LAY the book on the table.'
        'I LAID the book on the table.'

  ⚠ Chalkashtirmang: 'lie' ning O'TMIShI
  ham 'LAY'!

  ⚠ Jadvalda YO'Q, lekin bilish kerak:
     LIE — LIED — LIED = yolg'on gapirmoq
     (bu — TO'G'RI fe'l!)


QANDAY YODLASh KERAK:
  1) Guruhlar bo'yicha (A-A-A, A-B-B, A-B-C)
  2) Ovoz chiqarib UCh shaklni birga aytish
  3) Har fe'lni GAP ichida yodlash
  4) Kuniga 5-10 ta fe'l

exercises.instructionUz: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: be — cut (19 ta fe'l)
exercises.explanationUz:
BIRINChI QISM — 19 TA FE'L:

  be      was/were   been      bo'lmoq
  bear    bore       born(e)   tug'moq;
                               ko'tarmoq
  beat    beat       beaten    urmoq; yutmoq
  become  became     become    bo'lmoq
  begin   began      begun     boshlamoq
  bite    bit        bitten    tishlamoq
  blow    blew       blown     puflamoq
  break   broke      broken    sindirmoq
  bring   brought    brought   olib kelmoq
  build   built      built     qurmoq
  burn    burnt      burnt     yonmoq
  burst   burst      burst     yorilmoq
  buy     bought     bought    sotib olmoq
  can     could      (been able to)  ...a olmoq
  catch   caught     caught    ushlamoq
  choose  chose      chosen    tanlamoq
  come    came       come      kelmoq
  cost    cost       cost      turmoq (narx)
  cut     cut        cut       kesmoq


⚠ DIQQAT QILISh KERAK:

  'BE' — 2-shaklda IKKI variant:
     I / he / she / it → WAS
     you / we / they   → WERE
     3-shakl bitta — BEEN

  'BECOME' va 'COME' — 1 va 3-shakl BIR XIL:
     become — became — BECOME
     come — came — COME

  'BEAT' — 1 va 2-shakl bir xil:
     beat — BEAT — beaten

  'BURST', 'COST', 'CUT' — uchalasi bir xil.

  'BRING' va 'BUY' — bir xil oxir:
     bring — brought — brought
     buy — bought — bought
     (catch — caught — caught ham shunga
      o'xshash)


GAP NAMUNALARI:
  'I HAVE BEEN to London.' (borib keldim)
  'She BECAME a doctor.'
  'He has BROKEN his leg.'
  'We BOUGHT some postcards.' (115-bet)
  'It COST 10 pounds.'

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 2-shaklda IKKI variant:
  I/he/she/it → WAS
  you/we/they → WERE
3-shakl bitta: BEEN.

'I have BEEN to London.' = borib keldim.

⚠ IKKI 3-shakl:
  BORN = tug'ilgan ('I was born in 2010')
  BORNE = ko'tarilgan, chidalgan

1 va 2-shakl BIR XIL: beat — BEAT.
3-shakl: beatEN.

'We BEAT them 3-0.'

⚠ 1 va 3-shakl BIR XIL:
become — became — BECOME.

'She has BECOME a doctor.'

i → a → u namunasi:
begin — began — begun
(drink, sing, ring, swim ham shunday).

3-shaklda '-EN' qo'shiladi: bitTEN.

'The dog has BITTEN him.'

-ow → -ew → -own namunasi:
blow, grow, know, throw ham shunday.

-oke → -oken namunasi:
break, speak, wake ham shunday.

'He has BROKEN his leg.'

'-ought' guruhi:
bring, buy, think, fight ham shunday.

'Please BRING your book.'

d → t: build — BUILT.

'They BUILT a new school.'

BURNT — Britaniya;
BURNED — Amerika.

114-bet, 1-mashq: 'to LIGHT a fire' (olov
yoqmoq) — 'burn' emas!

UCHALA SHAKL BIR XIL.

'The balloon BURST.'

'-ought' guruhi (bring, think, fight bilan).

115-bet: 'I BOUGHT some postcards there.'

⚠ 'can' ning haqiqiy 3-shakli YO'Q!
O'rniga 'BE ABLE TO':
  I WILL BE ABLE TO swim.
  I HAVE BEEN ABLE TO swim.

'will can' — XATO!

'-aught' guruhi:
catch — caught, teach — taught.

'I CAUGHT the bus.'

3-shaklda '-N': choseN.

'Have you CHOSEN yet?'

⚠ 1 va 3-shakl BIR XIL:
come — came — COME.

'She has COME home.'
('has came' XATO!)

UCHALA SHAKL BIR XIL.

'How much did it COST?'
'It COST 10 pounds.'

UCHALA SHAKL BIR XIL.

'I have CUT my finger.'

exercises.instructionUz: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: deal — hurt (29 ta fe'l)
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKINChI QISM — 29 TA FE'L:

  deal    dealt      dealt     ish yuritmoq
  dig     dug        dug       qazimoq
  do      did        done      qilmoq
  dream   dreamt     dreamt    tush ko'rmoq
  drink   drank      drunk     ichmoq
  drive   drove      driven    haydamoq
  eat     ate        eaten     yemoq
  fall    fell       fallen    yiqilmoq
  feed    fed        fed       boqmoq
  feel    felt       felt      his qilmoq
  fight   fought     fought    jang qilmoq
  find    found      found     topmoq
  flee    fled       fled      qochmoq
  fly     flew       flown     uchmoq
  forbid  forbade    forbidden taqiqlamoq
  forget  forgot     forgotten unutmoq
  forgive forgave    forgiven  kechirmoq
  freeze  froze      frozen    muzlamoq
  get     got        got       olmoq
  give    gave       given     bermoq
  go      went       gone      bormoq
  grow    grew       grown     o'smoq
  hang    hung       hung      osmoq
  have    had        had       ega bo'lmoq
  hear    heard      heard     eshitmoq
  hide    hid        hidden    yashirmoq
  hit     hit        hit       urmoq
  hold    held       held      ushlab turmoq
  hurt    hurt       hurt      og'ritmoq


⚠ DIQQAT QILISh KERAK:

  'GO' — 3-shakl IKKI xil ma'noda:
     'has GONE' = ketdi, HALI u yerda
     'has BEEN' = borib KELDI
     (Unit 15 ning asosiy qoidasi!)

  'HANG' — IKKI xil 2/3-shakl:
     HUNG = osilgan (rasm, kiyim)
     HANGED = osib o'ldirilgan (odam)

  'FORBID' — 'forbidden' 115-betda bor:
     'You mustn't feed the animals — it's
      FORBIDDEN.'

  '-N' bilan tugaydiganlar:
     driven, eaten, fallen, flown, forbidden,
     forgotten, forgiven, frozen, given,
     gone, grown, hidden

  A-B-B guruhi (2 va 3 bir xil):
     dealt, dug, dreamt, fed, felt, fought,
     found, fled, got, had, heard, held

  A-A-A guruhi:
     hit, hurt


GAP NAMUNALARI:
  'I have EATEN at an Indian restaurant.'
     (115-bet)
  'I nearly FORGOT!' (115-bet)
  'They have GONE to the zoo.' (114-bet)
  'There are things I haven't DONE yet.'
     (115-bet)

pairs.whyUz:
'deal WITH something' = biror ish bilan
shug'ullanmoq.
Talaffuzi: /delt/.

i → u: dig — DUG.

'They DUG a hole.'

⚠ UCHALA SHAKL BOSHQA.

115-bet: 'things I haven't DONE yet'.
'DID you do it?' — 'did' dan keyin 1-shakl!

i → a → u namunasi
(begin, sing, ring, swim, sink bilan bir xil).

'Have you DRUNK your milk?'

3-shaklda '-N': driveN.

'He has DRIVEN a car for 10 years.'

3-shaklda '-EN': eatEN.

115-bet: 'I have EATEN at an Indian
restaurant too!'

3-shaklda '-EN': fallEN.

'He has FALLEN off his bike.'

ee → e: feed — FED.

115-bet: 'You mustn't FEED the animals.'

ee → e + t: feel — FELT.

'I FELT tired.'

'-ought' guruhi
(bring, buy, think bilan).

'They FOUGHT bravely.'

i → ou: find — FOUND.

114-bet: 'to FIND a better job'.
⚠ 'find' (topmoq) ↔ 'earn' (ishlab topmoq).

ee → e: flee — FLED.

'They FLED from the fire.'

-ew → -own (blow, grow, know, throw bilan).

115-bet: 'We are FLYING to Spain.'

115-bet: 'it's FORBIDDEN' (taqiqlangan).

'FORBIDDEN' — sifat sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

115-bet: 'I nearly FORGOT!'

'get' bilan bir xil namuna, lekin 3-shakli
'forgotten' ('forgot' emas).

'give' bilan bir xil namuna:
give — gave — given
forgive — forgave — forgiven

'choose' bilan o'xshash:
freeze — froze — frozen.

'FROZEN food' = muzlatilgan ovqat.

AmE da 3-shakl 'GOTTEN' ham bo'ladi.

'I have GOT a headache.' (114-bet)
'get up', 'get on', 'get off' — ko'p
ibora yasaydi.

3-shaklda '-N': giveN.

'He has GIVEN me a present.'

⚠ UNIT 15 NING ASOSIY QOIDASI:
  'has GONE' = ketdi, HALI u yerda
  'has BEEN' = borib KELDI

114-bet: 'They have gone to the zoo
YESTERDAY' — XATO, 'WENT' bo'lishi kerak.

-ow → -ew → -own
(blow, fly, know, throw bilan).

'grow up' = katta bo'lmoq.

⚠ IKKI MA'NO:
  HUNG = osilgan (rasm, kiyim)
  HANGED = osib o'ldirilgan (odam)

'I HUNG the picture on the wall.'

115-bet: 'I HAD a very hot curry!'

'I have HAD a headache all day.'
(birinchi 'have' — yordamchi, 'had' — asosiy)

⚠ YOZILISHI: 'heard' (hear + d).
TALAFFUZI: /hɜːd/ — 'hear' /hɪə/ dan farqli!

'listen' — ataylab tinglamoq;
'hear' — beixtiyor eshitmoq.

3-shaklda 'd' ikkilanadi + '-EN': hidDEN.

'He has HIDDEN the key.'

UCHALA SHAKL BIR XIL.

'The car HIT a tree.'

o → e: hold — HELD.

'HOLD my hand!'
'They HELD a party.'

UCHALA SHAKL BIR XIL.

'My leg HURTS.' (og'riyapti)
'I HURT my leg.' (jarohatladim)

exercises.instructionUz: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: keep — put (16 ta fe'l)
exercises.explanationUz:
UChINChI QISM — 16 TA FE'L:

  keep   kept    kept     saqlamoq
  know   knew    known    bilmoq
  lay    laid    laid     qo'ymoq, yotqizmoq
  lead   led     led      boshlab bormoq
  learn  learnt  learnt   o'rganmoq
  leave  left    left     tark etmoq;
                          qoldirmoq
  lend   lent    lent     qarz bermoq
  let    let     let      ruxsat bermoq
  lie    lay     lain     yotmoq
  light  lit     lit      yoqmoq (olov)
  lose   lost    lost     yo'qotmoq
  make   made    made     yasamoq, qilmoq
  mean   meant   meant    anglatmoq
  meet   met     met      uchrashmoq
  pay    paid    paid     to'lamoq
  put    put     put      qo'ymoq


⚠ ENG QIYIN JOY — 'LAY' va 'LIE':

  LAY — LAID — LAID  = qo'ymoq (nimanidir)
     'I LAY the book on the table.'
     'I LAID the book on the table.'

  LIE — LAY — LAIN   = yotmoq (o'zi)
     'I LIE on the bed.'
     'I LAY on the bed yesterday.'

  ⚠ Ya'ni 'LAY' — bir fe'lning 1-shakli,
  boshqa fe'lning 2-shakli!

  ⚠ Jadvalda YO'Q, lekin bilish kerak:
     LIE — LIED — LIED = yolg'on gapirmoq
     (TO'G'RI fe'l!)


⚠ 'LEND' va 'BORROW' FARQI:
  LEND = qarz BERMOQ
     'I LENT him my book.'
  BORROW = qarz OLMOQ
     'I BORROWED his book.'


⚠ 'MEAN' — 'meant' TALAFFUZI:
  mean /miːn/ → meant /ment/
  Yozilishi 'mean+t', talaffuzi o'zgaradi.


⚠ 'LEARN' — ikki shakl:
  LEARNT (Britaniya) / LEARNED (Amerika)


A-B-B guruhi (bu qismda deyarli hammasi):
  kept, laid, led, learnt, left, lent, lit,
  lost, made, meant, met, paid

A-A-A: let, put
A-B-C: know (knew/known), lie (lay/lain)


GAP NAMUNALARI:
  'I want to KEEP FIT.' (114-bet)
  'You mustn't LIGHT fires.' (114-bet)
  'I want to LOSE some weight.' (115-bet)
  'Did they KNOW about aliens?' (113-bet)

pairs.whyUz:
ee → e + pt: keep — KEPT.

114-bet: 'I want to KEEP FIT.'
'KEEP the room clean.' (Coursebook 101-bet)

-ow → -ew → -own
(blow, fly, grow, throw bilan).

113-bet: 'DID THEY KNOW about aliens?'
('did' dan keyin 1-shakl!)

⚠ 'lie' (yotmoq) bilan CHALKASHTIRMANG!

LAY = nimanidir qo'ymoq (obyekti bor)
'I LAID the book on the table.'

YOZILISHI: 'laid' ('layed' XATO).

ea → e: lead /liːd/ — LED /led/.

('read' bilan o'xshash, lekin 'lead' da
YOZILISHI ham o'zgaradi.)

ea → e + ft: leave — LEFT.

113-bet: 'join' ↔ 'LEAVE' zid juftligi.
'I LEFT my bag at home.'

d → t: lend — LENT.

⚠ LEND = qarz BERMOQ
   BORROW = qarz OLMOQ
'I LENT him my book.' / 'He BORROWED it.'

UCHALA SHAKL BIR XIL.

112-bet: 'LET'S develop the film.'
('let's' = let us — taklif)

⚠ ENG CHALKASH FE'L!

'lie' ning 2-shakli — 'LAY', bu esa boshqa
fe'lning 1-shakli ('lay' = qo'ymoq).

⚠ Jadvalda YO'Q, lekin bor:
LIE — LIED — LIED = yolg'on gapirmoq
(TO'G'RI fe'l).

114-bet, 1-mashqning 9-bandi:
'You mustn't LIGHT fires in the forest.'

⚠ 'light a fire' = olov YOQMOQ
   'burn' = yonmoq, kuydirmoq

115-bet: 'I want to LOSE some weight.'

'lose weight' = vazn tashlamoq
'lose a game' = o'yinda yutqazmoq

ake → ade: make — MADE.

114-bet: 'to MAKE new things'.
'MAKE the bed' = ko'rpa-to'shakni yig'ishtirmoq

⚠ TALAFFUZ o'zgaradi:
mean /miːn/ → meant /ment/

'What does it MEAN?'

ee → e: meet — MET.

'Have you MET her before?'
(Present Perfect + before — tajriba)

⚠ YOZILISHI: 'paid' ('payed' XATO).
'lay — laid' bilan bir xil qoida.

Coursebook 101-bet: 'PAY the rent on time.'

UCHALA SHAKL BIR XIL.

'PUT posters on the walls.' (101-bet)
'PUT ON weight' = vazn olmoq

exercises.instructionUz: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: read — shut (17 ta fe'l)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RTINChI QISM — 17 TA FE'L:

  read  /riːd/  read /red/  read /red/  o'qimoq
  ride   rode    ridden   minmoq
  ring   rang    rung     jiringlamoq;
                          qo'ng'iroq qilmoq
  rise   rose    risen    ko'tarilmoq
  run    ran     run      yugurmoq
  say    said    said     aytmoq
  see    saw     seen     ko'rmoq
  seek   sought  sought   izlamoq
  sell   sold    sold     sotmoq
  send   sent    sent     jo'natmoq
  set    set     set      qo'ymoq; botmoq
  sew    sewed   sewn     tikmoq (igna
                          bilan)
  shake  shook   shaken   silkitmoq
  shine  shone   shone    porlamoq
  shoot  shot    shot     otmoq
  show   showed  shown    ko'rsatmoq
  shut   shut    shut     yopmoq


⚠ 'READ' — ENG ALDAMChI FE'L:

  YOZILIShI uchala shaklda BIR XIL: read
  TALAFFUZI esa o'zgaradi:

     1-shakl: read /riːd/  (uzun 'ii')
     2-shakl: read /red/   (qisqa 'e')
     3-shakl: read /red/   (qisqa 'e')

  'I READ /riːd/ books every day.'
  'I READ /red/ a book yesterday.'


⚠ 'RUN' — 1 va 3-shakl BIR XIL:
  run — ran — RUN
  ('come' va 'become' kabi)


⚠ 'SAY' va 'TELL' FARQI:
  SAY something (TO somebody)
     'He SAID hello TO me.'
  TELL somebody something
     'He TOLD me a story.'

  113-bet: 'to TELL jokes' ('say jokes' XATO)


⚠ IKKI ShAKLLI FE'LLAR:
  sew  — sewed — SEWN (SEWED)
  show — showed — SHOWN

  Ikkalasida ham 2-shakl '-ed' bilan,
  3-shakl '-n' bilan.


⚠ 'SHINE' — ikki ma'no:
  shine — shone — shone = porlamoq
  ('shined' — poyabzalni yaltiratmoq
   ma'nosida ishlatiladi)
